--- create_index_interleave_named_schema.sql
CREATE INDEX app.Idx ON app.Child (Id), INTERLEAVE IN app.Parent

--- AST
&ast.CreateIndex{
  Rparen: 37,
  Name:   &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 13,
        NameEnd: 16,
        Name:    "app",
      },
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 17,
        NameEnd: 20,
        Name:    "Idx",
      },
    },
  },
  TableName: &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 24,
        NameEnd: 27,
        Name:    "app",
      },
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 28,
        NameEnd: 33,
        Name:    "Child",
      },
    },
  },
  Keys: []*ast.IndexKey{
    &ast.IndexKey{
      DirPos: -1,
      Lparen: -1,
      Rparen: -1,
      Name:   &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 35,
        NameEnd: 37,
        Name:    "Id",
      },
    },
  },
  InterleaveIn: &ast.InterleaveIn{
    Comma:     38,
    TableName: &ast.Path{
      Idents: []*ast.Ident{
        &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 54,
          NameEnd: 57,
          Name:    "app",
        },
        &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 58,
          NameEnd: 64,
          Name:    "Parent",
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE INDEX app.Idx ON app.Child(Id), INTERLEAVE IN app.Parent
